job.title: Security Support Engineer
job.pay_full: $90,650 – $108,780 a year estimated salary range; may be eligible for Fastly's equity and discretionary bonus programs

details.about: Fastly's edge cloud platform helps companies build fast, secure digital experiences by processing, serving and securing applications close to their users. This Security Support Engineer joins the Security Product Support (SPS) team, which gives operational support for Fastly's security products, including its Next-Gen WAF, to customers around the world and works with operations, product engineering and customer teams.
duties: Support customers with installing, configuring and troubleshooting Fastly's security products, including the Next-Gen WAF
Manage incoming customer inquiries and help customers secure their web applications
Troubleshoot and triage customer-reported WAF and security product issues, including security incidents
Document common issues, fixes and best practices for internal knowledge bases and runbooks
Handle inquiries and alerts within agreed service levels (SLAs) and escalate complex issues to senior team members
Help build scalable processes and policies as the organization grows
needs: Strong interest in infosec and application security
Foundational understanding of common web application vulnerabilities (e.g. OWASP Top 10)
Working knowledge of DNS, HTTP and TLS, and an understanding of the OSI model
Some experience with command-line Linux server environments (Windows Server a plus)
1+ years in a technical support, DevOps or solutions engineering role, ideally around application security, web infrastructure or cloud
Practical troubleshooting experience with WAF products, network proxies or application delivery controllers
Fluent spoken and written English, and a focus on great customer experiences
nice: Familiarity with configuring, deploying or managing applications on AWS, Azure or GCP, or with CI/CD pipelines
details.benefits: Estimated salary range $90,650 – $108,780 a year; starting pay depends on experience, skills, qualifications and location. The role may be eligible for Fastly's equity and discretionary bonus programs, and benefits start on the first day of employment.
notes: Work hours: Tuesday to Saturday, around 9am – 6pm Eastern
Listed for New York City, NY; open to remote work on US-East hours
Travel as required by the role or requested by your manager
The posting may close early due to the volume of applicants
Fastly says all applications go through its official careers site and it never asks for Social Security, bank or card details
